name: Pictural Story -twei-
source:
A boy has zero art skills, so he goes to the cultural center of the country to learn painting. He meets many girls there who may agree to pose as models.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名毫无绘画基础的少年来到这个国家的文化中心，学习绘画。他在那里结识了许多女孩，她们或许会答应担任他的绘画模特。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
